headline: Fantastic Frank Stockholm Showroom / ASKA
context: Architecture practice ASKA unveils a new showroom for real estate agency Fantastic Frank in Stockholm, following its visual identity update. A full renovation of a 160 square meters ground floor unit where brand, history and materiality are stitched together by a green thread.
